author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Ukraine reported at least nine people killed in Russian attacks across the country Saturday as President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Moscow had launched nearly 500 drones since early morning. The updated figures represented a substantial rise from earlier reports and kept the nationwide strike wave an active developing story.

Local authorities reported three deaths in Kramatorsk, two at a grocery store in the Zhytomyr region, two in Zaporizhzhia and two in Kryvyi Rih. Nearly 40 people were injured in the Odesa region. Russia said its forces targeted industrial sites, while Ukraine said civilian buildings and infrastructure were among the locations hit. Reuters said it could not independently verify all battlefield accounts.

The drone activity also disrupted neighboring Moldova, which temporarily closed its airspace and reported seven crossings. Ukraine said it struck an industrial facility in Togliatti, Russia, that produces synthetic rubber used in missile fuel. Russian-controlled authorities separately reported three deaths in Donetsk from Ukrainian strikes.
dek: The updated toll and drone count marked a significant escalation from earlier reports of Saturday’s nationwide strikes.
headline: Ukraine reports nine dead as Russia launches nearly 500 drones
